data.cultural_impact: Gajraj is a revered name in Hindu culture, symbolizing power, strength, and royalty. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra, the king of gods, is often depicted riding on an elephant and is known by the name Gajraj. The name is also given to other powerful and majestic beings, reflecting the esteemed status and strength associated with it.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gajraj holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism as it connects to Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and power. The name represents the divine qualities of strength, power, and royalty, reminding us to strive for inner wisdom, courage, and king-like qualities to lead our lives with dignity and purpose. By invoking the name Gajraj, one can seek Lord Indra's blessings for protection, power, and prosperity.
